title: krn adopt --verify and doctor name the GitHub App not installed on a repository with the install URL
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114d slice 5: census verify 14/15 exit 64 with raw 'gh api repos/{owner}/{repo} failed: Not Found (HTTP 404)'.
Outcome: a 404 on the repository becomes 'GitHub App not installed on <owner>/<repo>: install at <url>' with a distinct exit; doctor --unattended --root <repo> checks the same.
Proof: test with a verbatim captured gh 404 reply (KRN-12).
